description: This file defines a custom Java annotation `AllParametersAndReturnValuesAreNonnullByDefault` in the package `org.eclipse.ditto.utils.jsr305.annotations`. The annotation is used to specify that method parameters and return values are `@Nonnull` by default within annotated packages, classes, or methods. It includes metadata annotations and references related to nullability annotations in Java.

classes.name: AllParametersAndReturnValuesAreNonnullByDefault
classes.description: Custom Java annotation to enforce non-null constraints on method parameters and return values by default within the scope of its application.
